supply_risks: Movement STEP unavailable; cavity uses published common housing envelope, not an exact asset fit check.
14 mm total shaft does not specify threaded length; confirm nut engages on the 2.4 mm dial with supplied washer before final assembly.
User states 90 mm maximum; image labels minute hand 102 mm. Flat radius 108 mm accommodates both.
Integrated0.2mm relief with a hand underside at least1.1mm above the base plane leaves a nominal0.9mm running gap;14mm total shaft length alone does not prove the actual hand height.
Prototype populated by manual SMT/module soldering; no JLC SMT placement package is requested or claimed.
No verified drop-in alternate for 0.84 mm WS2812B-2020-V6; do not substitute an older 2020 revision without pinout/timing review.
XIAO ESP32C6 was compared: same nominal footprint but adds Wi-Fi 6/Thread not required; not a drop-in firmware/antenna substitute.
LED white maximum 10 x 36 mA = 360 mA; provision 500 mA Wi-Fi transient margin and 1 A supply. A 25% LED brightness cap is the default, not the hardware current rating.
Optical baffle reduces included geometry movement-height allowance from bare20.4mm to19.2mm; still above required17mm. Released PCB fit has not been measured.
Firmware source and local API specification provided but no compiler found and no hardware testing performed.

Both final filled boards have0 unconnected items. Independent KiCad DRC: power_entry0 errors/0 warnings; progress0 errors/18 bottom-side library mismatch warnings. Formal checks remain blocked by proven origin/center coordinate conversion fault; no manufacturing Release or released PCB installation verification exists.
